item.title: One Fire, Three Decades: Why Did China's Straw Burning Ban Move from Targeted Control to Comprehensive Prohibition? (Part 2)
item.description: An in-depth review of the key turning points of China's straw burning ban policy from 2008 to 2015: Olympic air quality assurance, comprehensive bans in Jiangsu, fiscal subsidies tied to fire points in Anhui, legislation in Hubei, and satellite fire-point monitoring.
